observations.detail: The bound Cloudflare resources contain no malware-scanner service or endpoint.
Authoritative ClamD operation requires externally supplied host and port configuration.
The local fallback performs policy and EICAR checks, not authoritative malware-engine classification.
Clean and EICAR live proof requires explicit provider configuration and an available ClamD-compatible service.

fail_closed_product_impact: Scan-required uploads cannot be represented as authoritatively clean until an external provider is separately authorized, configured, and observed.
